scope: All locally available iOS Sources/Components Swift files and all Android component-tree Kotlin files. Cross-platform semantic UI families are deduplicated; this is not a claim about every component in the shipped app.
countingUnit: One semantic UI family, deduplicated across iOS/Android. Button color/size/state variants are one family; separately exposed controls with distinct user interaction (PIN, phone, masked input, pager, sheet) are separate. Source files, preview fixtures, model classes, internal rendering functions and adapters are not counted as extra UI families.

statusDefinitions.exported: A dedicated matching reusable semantic family exists in the public React barrel. This does not assert complete variant coverage or pixel-level visual parity.
statusDefinitions.partial: A related reusable API or embedded implementation exists, with explicit important source variants/behavior or standalone API still absent.
statusDefinitions.example-only: The pattern is implemented only within example screen markup/state/CSS; it is not an exported reusable family.
statusDefinitions.missing: No implementation of this family was found. Generic children/ReactNode slots or raw HTML composition are not credited as completed source components.

limitations: The official viewer does not disclose a source revision/commit. Audit date is not source-release date.
The local mirror matches the saved official component trees by path. This proves scope completeness for those saved trees, not every screen, internal module or production component in mObywatel.
iOS standard system controls such as native alert, navigation and switches may be consumed outside Sources/Components and are not exhaustively represented here.
Native resource/drawable catalogues, typography, colors, illustrations, logos, app business flows and backend integrations are not counted as component families.
Matching public API presence is not proof of all states, all platforms, accessibility permutations or native pixel-perfect parity.
Only six press-reference mobile fixtures were visually reviewed; that cannot verify the appearance of all source families.
Desktop portal and public landing-page inventories are outside this mobile audit and require separate source inventories.
SingleCard has many rendering combinations. They are documented as missing variants under one family rather than inflated into separate component counts.
No official percentage-of-entire-product completeness is justified.

families.label: Accordion
families.assessment: Dedicated reusable accordion exists; native onListExpanded callback and per-item content-padding option are absent.

families.label: Inline alert
families.assessment: Alert exposes semantic tones, title/body, action and trailing slots. Source close control is supplied by caller through trailing; presence does not certify every native state visually.

families.label: Notification badge / dot
families.assessment: Native Android Badge is a small unlabeled notification marker. React Badge is primarily labeled; dot exists inside a labeled badge rather than a dedicated marker API.

families.label: Banner / high-emphasis banner
families.assessment: No reusable Banner with low/high-emphasis variants and close action. The desktop e-delivery hero is a separate domain example, not this family.

families.label: Bottom navigation
families.assessment: Reusable current/active icon, badges, selection callback, disabled items and optional home indicator. Used by mobile screens.

families.label: Modal bottom sheet
families.assessment: No bottom-sheet component, sheet state, drag interaction, content/footer layout or sheet-specific accessibility contract.

families.label: Primary / secondary / tertiary button family
families.assessment: Primary, secondary, tertiary and filled danger plus large/small exist. Native destructive secondary/tertiary and reversed secondary variants are not exposed.

families.label: Icon button
families.assessment: Dedicated icon button exposes glyph/small/large and several tones. No proof of every source ButtonVariant/State combination; native reversed and destructive combinations not all exposed.

families.label: Text button
families.assessment: Button variant=tertiary is the nearest API but has the large/small button box. Native TextButtonStyle is distinct, minHeight18, including destructiveText; no exact dedicated API.

families.label: Navigation link row style
families.assessment: ListRow onClick supplies title/content and trailing chevron. React uses a button rather than a native NavigationLink; routing is caller-owned.

families.label: Grouped card list
families.assessment: Grouped mobile cards, inset dividers and rows are hand-composed in sample-mobile-card/PhoneRow. There is no exported CardList with source COLUMN/LAZY modes.

families.label: Chat bubble with typing/CTA/footer
families.assessment: No ChatBubble, typing dots, message-footer actions or CTA family.

families.label: Single checkbox
families.assessment: Checked, disabled, label, hint and error exist. No indeterminate state, all linked-content variants or native group/shared error contract.

families.label: Checkbox group
families.assessment: Only individual Checkbox is exported; no group header/helper/group validation implementation.

families.label: Content box / surface container
families.assessment: Card provides a surface/container, but its header/content padding API differs from native ContentBox and no named equivalent is exported.

families.label: Two-item segmented controller
families.assessment: Tabs provide selection, but no native ControllerSwitch variant/layout contract; generic tabs are not proof of exact segmented-controller parity.

families.label: Filter controller
families.assessment: Generic tabs/chips can supply primitives; no source ControllerFilter styling/selection component is present.

families.label: File-source bottom-sheet item
families.assessment: No reusable file-source item UI; Android debounce and platform URI plumbing are adapters, not extra missing UI families.

families.label: Bullet point row
families.assessment: No dedicated bullet-label/bullet-point implementation. Generic HTML lists are possible but do not count as a matching library family.

families.label: Clickable rich text with linked spans
families.assessment: No annotated span/link semantics parser or dedicated rich clickable-text component.

families.label: Single-card document row
families.assessment: DocumentTile and DocumentCard have different layouts; no source document-thumbnail row family.

families.label: Native icon and icon-background wrapper
families.assessment: 53 named original native SVG assets and derived reference variants are exported. This is a selected asset set, not every Android drawable nor every IconData background/size/state variant.

families.label: Barcode custom card content
families.assessment: No barcode generator/custom single-card content family.

families.label: Label / button / generated image custom card content
families.assessment: No matching custom label/button/QR-image card family. Demo QR glyph is not a payload-encoding QR generator.

families.label: Date picker dialog
families.assessment: No exported calendar/date picker. Browser input type=date would not reproduce this dialog. ViewModel/picker-state bridge is platform adapter, not another UI family.

families.label: Modal dialog family
families.assessment: Accessible generic dialog is exported. Native WithText/WithIcon/WithThreeButtons layouts are not named variants; exact iOS-style compact PESEL alert lives in private PhoneDialog example.

families.label: Dropdown selector / selection list
families.assessment: Native HTML select with labels/help/errors is exported. iOS selected-row checkmark list/dismiss behavior and Android click-trigger presentation are not recreated by Select.

families.label: Empty state
families.assessment: Title, description, icon and action slots exist. Native platform optional-title/visual differences remain outside a proof of all-state parity.

families.label: Field error text
families.assessment: Error text and announcement are implemented inside fields/choices. No standalone exported ErrorText.

families.label: File picker
families.assessment: No file attachment UI, selected-file states, delete action or chooser API. Native launcher/URI handling is a platform adapter inside this one family.

families.label: Icon / title / description hero header
families.assessment: PESEL example reproduces HeaderView circle72/icon40/title/description. Exported AppHeader is navigation chrome, not this hero family.

families.label: Field helper text
families.assessment: Helper text exists through hint props; no standalone exported HelperText.

families.label: Centered icon page template
families.assessment: No reusable IconPage with title/description/subDescription/content/bottom-content contract. Generic EmptyState and demo QR page are not the full template.

families.label: Information row / information row list
families.assessment: ListRow covers icon/title/description. Native dedicated info-row typography, row-list spacing and all bullet variants are not exposed.

families.label: Date / time trigger input
families.assessment: TextField accepts native HTML date/time types and leading/trailing slots. No dedicated source trigger control with DD.MM.RRRR/GG:MM placeholder and onClick picker behavior.

families.label: Inline link
families.assessment: No exported Link component. Breadcrumbs render anchors only inside breadcrumb navigation; tertiary Button remains a button and does not provide href semantics.

families.label: Popup menu
families.assessment: No menu trigger, menu items, focus/arrow-key handling or popup-menu API. Select is a different control.

families.label: Swipeable page controller / onboarding pager
families.assessment: No horizontal pager, page-specific next action or onboarding content controller. Pagination controls result pages and is a different family.

families.label: Pager dot indicator
families.assessment: No dot indicator bound to a horizontal pager.

families.label: Progress bar and labeled indicator
families.assessment: Reusable bounded value0–100 and optional label exist. Native rendered variants are not all independently visually verified.

families.label: Single radio item
families.assessment: Reusable native radio semantics, name grouping, checked/disabled, label/hint/error exist.

families.label: Radio group with header and support content
families.assessment: Only individual Radio is exported. No source group header/helper icon, supported row variants or group-level error API.

families.label: Structured result modal
families.assessment: Generic Dialog can host children but no structured result icon/data pairs/three-actions result template is implemented.

families.label: Search field / search bar
families.assessment: Dedicated exported search control with native search/clear icons, value handling and label; used by reference mobile services fixture.

families.label: Service welcome page
families.assessment: No reusable source welcome-page composition with its image/text/data/actions.

families.label: Single card variants
families.assessment: Basic info/clickable rows exist. Source selectable-checkbox/selectable-radio, reversed title/detail, delete/action and status-badge combinations are not packaged as source-equivalent variants.

families.label: Large squircle shortcut card
families.assessment: No80px squircle background with32px icon, centered caption and native small-card dimensions. ServiceTile is a horizontal row, not this card.

families.label: Small circular shortcut card
families.assessment: Unifies equivalent iOS ShortcutCard and Android SmallCardS:80px column,48px icon background,24px icon. No exported implementation.

families.label: Snackbar / toast
families.assessment: Timed toast exists inside MobileScreen state. No exported snackbar host, controller, duration/dismiss-action API.

families.label: Status badge dot / icon / bordered
families.assessment: Badge tone/dot/icon and status/bordered variants cover the source semantic family. This mapping is presence, not a full snapshot matrix.

families.label: Support / outcome page
families.assessment: No reusable support result page with native illustration/icon/title/description/actions.

families.label: Switch with label / extras
families.assessment: Controlled/uncontrolled checked, disabled, label/hint exist. Native standalone switch and extras link/text-button plus validation contract are not separate supported variants.

families.label: Text area
families.assessment: Label, value, native textarea attrs, hint/error and fixed rows exist. Native automatic character counter and flexible max-lines mode are not implemented.

families.label: Text / numeric / password input
families.assessment: TextField covers base/text/numeric/password, labels, hints/errors, leading/trailing, clear action and password visibility. Native IME/focus APIs are platform adapters, not extra components.

families.label: Phone number with country prefix
families.assessment: TextField type=tel is only a raw single field. No separate prefix/number values, validation and composed PhoneNumber input.

families.label: PIN / OTP cell input
families.assessment: No multi-cell PIN entry, masking, focus movement or length handling.

families.label: Masked formatted input
families.assessment: No formatter/mask integration. Native transformation object is platform-specific, but the user-visible masked-input behavior is a missing variant.

families.label: Small / medium / large top app bar
families.assessment: AppHeader offers brand/title/leading/actions slots. No source small/medium/large or scroll/collapse variants; exact back/large-title headers are hand-composed in examples.

families.label: Overlapping cards stack layout
families.assessment: No reusable overlapping card-stack layout with source spacing/proposal behavior. It is a real visual layout, not merely a native adapter.

families.label: Full document card
families.assessment: Dedicated226px card with supplied artwork/title/trailing slot and matching layout constants is exported.

families.label: Small document tile
families.assessment: Dedicated tile with title/icon/custom background or four current artwork variants is exported. Four artwork variants are not the complete app document catalogue.

families.label: Illustration page template
families.assessment: No reusable centered illustration/title/description/content page template.

families.label: List header title / description
families.assessment: No exported ListHeader. Card title alone and section headings lack this distinct22pt title/13pt description layout contract.

families.label: Section header and content
families.assessment: Service sections and PESEL history manually render this pattern. No exported SectionHeader with the source title/content spacing.

families.label: Timeline
families.assessment: No timeline dots, connecting line, date/header, title and description list API. PESEL history navigation rows are not a timeline.

files.supportOnlyReason: Shared Bitmap/image configuration model; this source file declares no composable Image implementation, so it does not create another UI family.
